stage_extranodal_sites.quote: plus extranodal deposits in the right kidney (3.2 cm, SUVmax 19.6), left adrenal (2.6 cm, SUVmax 17.2) and hepatic segment VI (1.8 cm, SUVmax 15.0).

stage_b_symptoms.quote: with B symptoms (drenching night sweats most nights and 8 kg, about 10%, unintentional weight loss over two months)

mn_stage_below_iv.quote: Stage IVB (Lugano/Ann Arbor) with B symptoms

mol_not_de_not_dh.quote: FISH (2026-09-16) shows no MYC, BCL2 or BCL6 rearrangement, so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma; the immunophenotype is also not double-expressor (MYC 20%, BCL2 30%).

prog_cns_ipi_high.quote: CNS-IPI 6/6 (age >60, ECOG >1, elevated LDH, more than one extranodal site, stage III/IV, and renal/adrenal involvement)

tx_curative_pola_or_rchop.quote: Curative-intent systemic therapy with Pola-R-CHP for 6 cycles: polatuzumab vedotin 1.8 mg/kg IV day 1, rituximab 375 mg/m2 IV day 1, cyclophosphamide 750 mg/m2 IV day 1, doxorubicin 50 mg/m2 IV day 1

tx_pola_preferred.quote: Pola-R-CHP is a category 1 NCCN preferred regimen and improved progression-free survival versus R-CHOP in POLARIX

tx_prephase_steroid.quote: I will give a short prednisone pre-phase (100 mg daily for 5 days) with glucose monitoring before cycle 1 to reduce tumor burden and tumor-lysis risk

mn_non_curative.quote: He is fit for full-dose anthracycline-based curative therapy

mn_da_epoch.quote: so this is not a double-hit or triple-hit high-grade B-cell lymphoma; the immunophenotype is also not double-expressor

mn_dose_reduced_initial.quote: I do not plan pre-emptive dose reduction.

cns_risk_addressed.quote: High risk: CNS-IPI 6/6 (age >60, ECOG >1, elevated LDH, more than one extranodal site, stage III/IV, and renal/adrenal involvement).

cns_staging_mri_csf.quote: I will obtain a baseline contrast-enhanced MRI brain and a lumbar puncture with CSF cytology and flow cytometry before starting therapy

cns_prophylaxis_renal.quote: the absolute benefit of CNS prophylaxis in the rituximab era is modest and not proven in randomized trials, and his renal impairment creates a real risk of methotrexate nephrotoxicity; I will reassess renal function after one to two cycles

mn_hdmtx_now_despite_aki.quote: two doses interdigitated between cycles (for example after cycles 2 and 4 or after completion), with dose reduction or omission if the eGFR remains about 50 or renal involvement worsens

resp_eot_pet_lugano.quote: Definitive assessment is an end-of-treatment PET-CT about 6-8 weeks after cycle 6 and no sooner than 3-4 weeks after the last rituximab. Deauville 1-3 constitutes a complete metabolic response

resp_ds45_biopsy.quote: Deauville 4-5 at end of treatment is considered residual disease, and a Deauville 4 residual site should be biopsied because inflammatory uptake can persist.

sup_tls_prophylaxis.quote: start allopurinol 300 mg daily (renally adjusted) 2-3 days before cycle 1 and continue for 7-10 days after each cycle, with vigorous intravenous hydration (2-3 L/day as tolerated), frequent monitoring of uric acid, potassium, phosphate, calcium and creatinine

sup_rasburicase_g6pd.quote: Before cycle 1 I still need: G6PD level (required before any rasburicase)

sup_gcsf.quote: Pegfilgrastim primary prophylaxis with each cycle.

sup_stop_nsaid.quote: Stop ibuprofen now because of CKD, renal involvement and thrombocytopenia; use acetaminophen and, if needed, short-acting opioids for the abdominal pain.

sup_steroid_glucose.quote: Monitor glucose closely because of steroid-induced hyperglycemia (HbA1c 7.4%, on metformin), adjust diabetes therapy

work_hbv_reviewed.quote: confirm hepatitis B status: HBsAg negative, anti-HBc negative, anti-HBs positive indicates prior immunity, so no antiviral prophylaxis is needed.

work_echo_reviewed.quote: the LVEF of 60% and normal global longitudinal strain permit full-dose anthracycline

fit_ecog_disease_related.quote: the ECOG 2 is largely attributable to bulky lymphoma and B symptoms rather than irreversible comorbidity, and I expect it to improve. I will obtain a brief geriatric assessment to identify frailty, polypharmacy and social vulnerabilities, but I do not plan pre-emptive dose reduction. His explicit goal is cure
